reviews.rationale: Source explicitly states HRV varies person to person and lists age, sex, sleep, hormones, circadian rhythm, caffeine/alcohol, exercise, and stress as influencing factors. Title and content accurately reflect this.
Source states personal range is based on the average of recent data using up to 30 days. Content accurately paraphrases this for trend monitoring.
Source confirms users can view heart rate trends over a week, month, 3 months, or year, and see average resting heart rate over periods of time. Content is accurate.
Source states the vitals feature provides information for well-being and is not intended to diagnose or treat any medical condition. HRV is listed as one of these vitals. Content is supported.

Content claims Fitbit reports HRV using RMSSD, which is supported by the source. However, the source_url points to answer/14237938 (resting heart rate page), while the RMSSD text anchor appears in the source_context for answer/14237938's HRV section. The URL should likely be verified, but the core claim is present in the provided context block.
Source states the latest HRV measurement is from the longest sleep period over the past 24 hours and only sleep periods greater than 3 hours are considered. Content is fully supported.
Source advises keeping an eye on how things balance out over time rather than focusing too much on any one day, and mentions comparing data to a 30-day average for sleep stages. Content is accurate.
Source explicitly states 'For health concerns, consult a healthcare provider.' Content accurately reflects this directive.
Source states accuracy is affected by personal physiology, device placement, and activity, and advises ensuring the back of the device contacts the skin with a snug band. Content is supported.
Source troubleshooting advises wearing the device for at least one full day, 'during the day and to sleep at night'. Content accurately reflects this requirement for overnight vitals.
Source states most metrics require at least 3 hours of quality sleep and excessive movement or short sessions may result in no reading. Content is supported.
Source advises checking if the device synced recently and whether it tracks the specific metric. Content accurately reflects this.
Source notes variations between new and old Fitbit devices due to changes in the heart rate sensor or algorithm. Content is supported.
Source states time asleep is estimated as all time in the main sleep period identified as Light, Deep, or REM. Content accurately distinguishes this from total sleep period duration.
Source states wrist-based devices automatically detect sleep when worn to bed and recommends a snug wristband. Content is supported.
Source states Fitbit uses a 3-axis accelerometer to count steps and that the arm must swing back and forth during a walk or run for steps to be counted. Content is supported.
